domain_shift_notes: Figshare scans are 16-bit with varying intensity ranges and are min-max normalised per image before the shared pipeline; the internal set is 8-bit and natively 224x224.
Acquisition differs in scanner, sequence weighting and slice orientation, none of which is controlled for.
Figshare provides one label per slice and multiple slices per patient (PID); slice-level metrics therefore treat correlated slices as independent.
No non-tumour class exists externally, so the restricted score forgives every case the model would have answered No-tumor - see 'predicted_absent_class_count'.
